name: chest bench press grip width (form check)
description: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
